video.text: Ask the Tarnwick vault a question. The search runs in your browser, with no key.
Hybrid search: vectors, words and typed links. Each of the 5 results says why it came in.
Every sentence cites its source. The path lights the 3 links the answer walked.
A citation opens the exact passage the answer read.
Measured on 40 held-out questions. Hybrid search and graph only tie: recall@5 91% and 93%.
